'''''Star Wars: Jabba the Hutt''''' is an announced comic series by [[Marvel Comics]] focusing on [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|the character of the same name]]. It was first mentioned on [[December 13]], [[2023]] in an announcement for the then-upcoming one-shot [[Revelations (2023) 1|''Revelations'' (2023) 1]], which included the story "[[Duel of the Reprobates]]" by [[Marc Guggenheim]] and [[Salva Espín]]. However, unlike the other series previewed in ''Revelations'', no issues of the ''Jabba the Hutt'' series have been announced thus far.
